messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] How to estimate the parameters of Finite mixture model ?
parts:
You just need to write out the density in Stan. You can
implement that GB2 density directly. You'll want to do it
on the log scale, which may require some care to deal with
arithmetic stability.

I don't see the mixture part of your model spec, but if you want to see how
to do mixtures in Stan, check out the chapter of the manual
on mixture models.

We don't recommend the fat gamma priors.
The manual has recommendations in the regression chapter.

You may want to start with some simpler models in Stan
to get a feeling for how the constraints on parameters work.

- Bob
